source_runs.role: primary queue source (claims, answers, chunks, verdicts)
cross-validation of recovered citations for retracted claims (13/13 asserted); AI-draft label carrier

mini_review_file.used_as: nothing — excluded from the queue entirely

git.note: Untracked analysis/ directories are expected; only tracked-file state is reported as dirty.

queue_composition.tier4_sampling_rule: within each unchanged stratum (insufficient_evidence n=16, unverifiable n=16): sort by post-gate verif_claims.id, take every 2nd claim -> 8 per stratum, 16 total; deterministic, no randomness
queue_composition.retrieval_reconstruction: deterministic BM25 replay over the post-gate DB copy; validated 22/22 against stored retrieved_count
queue_composition.retracted_citations_recovery: gate anomaly-note ids == historical evidence_ids_json for 13/13 (asserted at generation); post-gate store is empty by design
queue_composition.tier5_note: the pre-existing rule anomaly (wrong-02 claim_index 0) already fell inside the tier-4 systematic sample, so tier 5 is 0 and the item is queued once at priority 4; coverage assertions verify it is present

honesty_statements.no_model_calls: TRUE: this queue was generated without any LLM/API call. Only SQLite reads, file reads, deterministic BM25, and regex parsing.
honesty_statements.no_invented_human_labels: TRUE: every human_label/rationale/reviewer_id/timestamp/adjudicated_label field is null in every item; review_status is not_reviewed for all 47 items. No default label of any kind exists.
honesty_statements.ai_labels_not_human: TRUE: proposed_ai_label values come from a self-declared AI-assisted draft and are marked non-ground-truth; they are excluded from the blind file and from all agreement/accuracy statistics.
honesty_statements.no_gold_label_writes: TRUE: gold_label columns remain NULL in both run databases; this stage writes nothing to any database.
